standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4551-4554)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the cohomology modules of the descended complex are finite over the source.

standard_prerequisites.name: The base change isomorphism for the derived internal hom along a flat map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5455-5459 and 5469-5470)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the base change of the internal hom with the internal hom of the base changed complex.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for finite injective dimension through the vanishing of the internal hom against finite modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5465-5466)
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the vanishing range of the internal hom into finite injective dimension of the complex.

core_obligations: Boundedness and finiteness: since the base change of the complex is bounded with finite cohomology modules over the target and the map is flat, the complex itself is bounded, and its cohomology modules are finite over the source by descent (proof lines 5449-5454)

Finite injective dimension: base change the internal hom against an arbitrary finite module, so that the vanishing above the amplitude bound of the base changed complex is visible over the target, and read it back over the source by faithful flatness; the criterion for finite injective dimension then applies (proof lines 5455-5466)

The duality map: base change the map from the source into the internal hom of the complex with itself and use that the corresponding map over the target is an isomorphism, which faithful flatness reflects (proof lines 5467-5473)
proof_roadmap: 平坦 ⇒ H^i(K) ⊗_A B = H^i(K ⊗_A^L B)；由 B 侧的有限性与代数里的下降引理，K 有界且 H^i(K) 是有限 A-模。
对有限 A-模 M，由 base-change-RHom：RHom_A(M,K) ⊗_A B = RHom_B(M ⊗ B, K ⊗^L B)，右端在 > b 次消失（b 为 B 侧内射幅度上界）；忠实平坦 ⇒ 左端同样消失 ⇒ 由内射幅度判据 K 的内射维数有限。
最后把 A → RHom_A(K,K) 用同一条 base-change-RHom 作基变换，B 侧已是同构，忠实平坦 ⇒ 原映射是同构，故 K 对偶。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that a complex over a Noetherian ring whose base change along a faithfully flat map of Noetherian rings is a dualizing complex over the target is itself a dualizing complex over the source (author lemma at source lines 5440-5446, label lemma-descent). The proof (source lines 5448-5474) descends boundedness and finiteness of the cohomology modules, base changes the derived internal hom against an arbitrary finite module to read off the vanishing range and hence finite injective dimension, and finally base changes the duality map into the internal hom of the complex with itself, where faithful flatness reflects the isomorphism (proof lines 5467-5473). The three descents are the substance. H3.
